release_notes: v0.5.0-rc8: RC8 jobs-mode installer compatibility. The rebuilt CallKavach-Setup.exe now creates config\engine.json during setup, enabling PostgreSQL jobs-mode startup on fresh installs. The app is BOM-tolerant when reading engine.json. Also: packaged exports fixed, dynamic issue filters, and the Celery worker is skipped in jobs mode to prevent broker log flood. Prerelease build for RC validation.
